Lurt 0.8.7 adds page zoom, and Lurt is now open source under the MIT License.

**Download Lurt:** [Windows (lurt.exe)](https://github.com/ladroxd/Lurt/releases/download/v0.8.7/lurt.exe) · [SHA-256 checksum](https://github.com/ladroxd/Lurt/releases/download/v0.8.7/lurt.exe.sha256)

No installer: download it and run it. Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because the app isn't signed; choose **More info → Run anyway**. Needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which Windows 10 and 11 already include.

## New

- **Zoom pages.** Ctrl + scroll, Ctrl + / -, Ctrl 0 or a touchpad pinch zooms websites. Settings → Appearance → Page zoom shows and sets it, and Lurt remembers it.
- **Open source.** MIT License, with a [privacy policy](https://github.com/ladroxd/Lurt/blob/main/PRIVACY.md) and a [code signing policy](https://github.com/ladroxd/Lurt/blob/main/CODE_SIGNING.md).
